result.description: Compact desktop environmental monitor designed for home studios, greenhouses, and small lab spaces. The Sentry Station tracks temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and ambient light in real time, and includes a color e-ink display, Wi-Fi sync, and optional alert scheduling through a companion app. Built for quiet always-on operation, it ships with a wall mount, tabletop stand, and a rechargeable backup battery for short outages.
